sanskrit: upo ṣu jātamapturaṃ gobhirbhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam . induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ
english: Come near to the one just born, swift-moving, purified with the cows' milk; the gods have eagerly approached the drop of Soma.

sanskrit: punāno akramīdabhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ . śumbhanti vipraṃ dhītibhiḥ
english: Purifying himself, the all-seeing one strides forth against all enemies; they adorn the inspired sage with their thoughts.

sanskrit: āviśankalaśaṃ suto viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ . indurindrāya dhīyate
english: Entering the vessel as he is pressed, streaming forth toward all glories, the drop of Soma is poured out for Indra.

sanskrit: asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ . kārṣmanvājī nyakramīt
english: Like a chariot-horse he has been released; pressed out, he flows through the filter in the two bowls; the steed has strode along the course.

sanskrit: pra yadgāvo na bhūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ . ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇāmapa tvacam
english: When, like rushing cows, the swift streams strode forth, striking off the dark skin.

sanskrit: apaghnanpavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvitsoma matsaraḥ . nudasvādevayuṃ janam
english: Driving away enemies as you purify yourself, O Soma, knower of sacred rites, exhilarating one — push away the ungodly people.

sanskrit: ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryamarocayaḥ . hinvāno mānuṣīrapaḥ
english: Purify yourself with that stream by which you caused the sun to shine, impelling the waters destined for mankind.

sanskrit: sa pavasva ya āvithendraṃ vṛtrāya hantave . vavrivāṃsaṃ mahīrapaḥ
english: Purify yourself, you who have aided Indra to smite Vṛtra — him who had enveloped the great waters.

sanskrit: ayā vītī pari srava yasta indo madeṣvā . avāhannavatīrnava
english: Flow around with this offering, O drop, you who in your raptures have driven away the ninety and nine.

sanskrit: pari dyukṣaṃ sanadrāyiṃ bharadvājaṃ no andhasā . svāno arṣa pavitra ā
english: Flow, roaring one, through the filter to Bharadvāja — the heaven-dwelling, ever-victorious one — with the Soma draught.

sanskrit: saṃ sūryeṇa didyute
english: He flashes together with the sun.

sanskrit: ā te dakṣaṃ mayobhuvaṃ vahnimadyā vṛṇīmahe . pāntamā puruspṛham
english: Today we choose your healing and bliss-bringing power, the carrier much-longed-for, the protector.

sanskrit: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā naya . punīhīndrāya pātave
english: O Adhvaryu, bring the Soma pressed with the stones to the filter; purify it for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: taratsa mandī dhāvati dhārā sutasyāndhasaḥ . taratsa mandī dhāvati
english: That gladdening stream of the pressed Soma flows crossing over; that gladdening one flows crossing over.

sanskrit: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ soma suvīryam . asme śravāṃsi dhāraya
english: Purify yourself, O Soma, flowing toward wealth of a thousandfold, full of heroic might; pour upon us your glories.

sanskrit: anu pratnāsa āyavaḥ padaṃ navīyo akramuḥ . ruce jananta sūryam
english: The ancient human sages stepped on the newer path; they generated the sun for its splendor.

sanskrit: arṣā soma dyumattamo 'bhi droṇāni roruvat . sīdanyonau yoneṣvā
english: Flow, O Soma, most brilliant, roaring toward the wooden troughs; settle in your proper stations, in the womb places.

sanskrit: vṛṣā soma dyumāṃ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ . vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhriṣe
english: You are a bull, O Soma, luminous; a bull, O god, with a bull's vow; as a bull you have upheld the laws.

sanskrit: iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ . indo rucābhi gā ihi
english: Purify yourself with your stream for refreshment, being cleansed by the wise; O drop, go toward the cows with your radiance.

sanskrit: mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ . avyo vārebhirasmayuḥ
english: O Soma, purify yourself with your exhilarating stream, O bull, seeking the gods, through the wool-filters, longing for us.

sanskrit: ayā soma sukṛtyapā mahāntsannabhyavardhathāḥ . hindāna idvṛṣāyase
english: By this, O Soma, protecting good deeds and being great, you have increased yourself; being impelled you indeed pour forth as a bull.

sanskrit: ayaṃ vicarṣaṇirhitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati . hinvāna āpyaṃ bṛhat
english: This all-seeing one is placed in motion; the Pavamāna is alive and aware; being spurred on, he impels the vast watery realm.

sanskrit: pra ṇa indo mahe tu na ūrmiṃ na bibhradarṣasi . abhi devāṃ ayāsyaḥ
english: Flow forth for us, O drop, not bearing a great wave against us; you hasten toward the gods.

sanskrit: apaghnanpavate mṛdho 'pa somo arāvṇaḥ . gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam
english: Soma drives away the enemies, he flows, washing away the churlish; going to his proper place in Indra.

sanskrit: ā ratnadhā yonimṛtasya sīdasyutso devo hiraṇyayaḥ
english: O bestower of treasures, take your seat in the womb of the truth; O golden divine spring, flow forth.

sanskrit: parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ . dadhanvāṃ yo naryo apsvā3ntarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ
english: Pour around the pressed Soma, he who is the highest offering; the manly one who has run swiftly, who has pressed Soma with the stones in the midst of the waters.

sanskrit: ā soma svāno adribhistiro vārāṇyavyayā . jano na puri camvorviśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhriṣe
english: O Soma, roaring, pressed with stones, pass through the wool filters of the sheep; like a man entering a stronghold, the tawny one enters the two bowls and takes his seat in the forests.

sanskrit: pra soma devavītaye sindhurna pipye arṇasā . aṃśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛviracchā kośaṃ madhuścutam
english: Flow forth, O Soma, for the delight of the gods, swelling with flood like a river; the invigorating, wakeful juice of the Soma plant streams toward the honey-dripping vessel.

sanskrit: soma u ṣvāṇaḥ sotṛbhiradhi ṣṇubhiravīnām . aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā
english: Soma, being pressed by the pressers upon the pressing stones from the sheep's wool, goes with a tawny stream like two horses; he goes with an exhilarating stream.

sanskrit: tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo divedive . purūṇi babhro ni caranti māmava paridhīṃrati tāṃ ihi
english: O Soma, I rejoice in your friendship, O drop, day by day; many things, O tawny one, move against me — protect me from them, going around that boundary, come.

sanskrit: mṛjyamānaḥ suhastyā samudre vācaminvasi . rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi
english: Being cleansed by the skilled hands, you set speech in motion in the sea; purifying yourself, you flow forward with tawny, abundant, much-desired wealth.

sanskrit: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam . samudrasyādhi viṣṭape manīṣiṇo matsarāso madacyutaḥ
english: The human Soma-drops purify themselves, an intoxicating joy; upon the ridge of the ocean, the wise and exhilarating ones, dropping with rapture.

sanskrit: punānaḥ soma jāgṛviravyā vāraiḥ pari priyaḥ . tvaṃ vipro abhavo 'ṅgirastama madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣa ṇaḥ
english: O Soma, purifying yourself, ever wakeful, beloved as you flow around through the wool filters; you have become the inspired sage, the most like Aṅgiras — sprinkle our sacrifice with honey.

sanskrit: indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ . sahasradhāro atyavyamarṣati tamī mṛjantyāyavaḥ
english: The rapturous Soma, pressed for Indra accompanied by the Maruts, flows with a thousandfold stream past the wool filter; men cleanse him.

sanskrit: pavasva vājasātamo 'bhi viśvāni vāryā . tvaṃ samudraḥ prathame vidharmaṃ devebhyaṃ soma matsaraḥ
english: Purify yourself, O most powerful winner of prizes, flowing toward all desirable things; you are the ocean, O Soma, exhilarating one, the first to spread the laws for the gods.

sanskrit: pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitramati dhārayā . marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhāmabhi prayāṃsi ca
english: The purifying ones have been released, flowing over the filter with their stream; accompanied by the Maruts, exhilarating, belonging to Indra, they hasten toward the sacrifice, toward the oblations and toward wisdom.

sanskrit: aśvaṃ na tvā vājinaṃ marjayanto 'cchā barhī raśanābhirnayanti
english: Cleansing you like a prize-winning horse, they lead you with reins toward the sacred grass.

sanskrit: pra kāvyamuśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti . mahivrataḥ śucibandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abhyeti rebhan
english: Speaking forth poetic wisdom like Uśanas, the divine one proclaims the origins of the gods; great in vow, pure in alliance, the purifier, the boar comes forward on foot, roaring.

sanskrit: tisro vāca īrayati pra vahnirṛtasya dhītiṃ brahmaṇo manīṣām . gāvo yanti gopatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ
english: The carrier stirs three utterances, the thought of truth, the wisdom of sacred prayer; the cows go seeking the lord of cows, the inspired thoughts go, longing, toward Soma.

sanskrit: asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ samapṛkta rasam . sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumanti hotā
english: Impelled by his impulse and drive, being purified, this god has mingled his essence with the gods; pressed and roaring, he goes around the filter like a friend, a hotar with cattle, going about his dwelling.

sanskrit: somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ . janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ
english: Soma purifies himself, the begetter of inspired thoughts, the begetter of heaven, the begetter of earth; the begetter of fire, the begetter of the sun, the begetter of Indra, and the begetter of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhāmāṅgoṣiṇamavāvaśanta vāṇīḥ . vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūrvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi
english: The voices have called out to the three-ridged, bull-like bestower of sustenance, the resounding one; clothed in the forest plants, like Varuṇa among rivers, the bestower of treasures distributes desirable things.

sanskrit: akrāntsamudraḥ prathame vidharmaṃ janayanprajā bhuvanasya gopāḥ . vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhatsomo vāvṛdhe svāno adriḥ
english: The ocean has strode first over the spreading ordinance, generating progeny, the guardian of the world; the bull upon the ridge, on the sheep's filter, the great Soma has grown, roaring like a pressing stone.

sanskrit: kanikranti harirā sṛjyamānaḥ sīdanvanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ . nṛbhiryataḥ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ gāmato matiṃ janayata svadhābhiḥ
english: The tawny one, roaring as he is poured out, settling purified in the belly of the wood; directed by men, he strips the hide from the cow, and from there, with his natural powers, he generates inspired thought.

sanskrit: eṣa sya te madhumāṃ indra somo vṛṣā vṛṣṇaḥ pari pavitre akṣāḥ
english: This is the honey-sweet Soma of yours, O Indra, the bull belonging to the bull — he has flowed around the filter; the giver of thousands, the giver of hundreds, the great giver, has repeatedly taken his stand at the sacred grass as the prize-winner.

sanskrit: pavasva soma madhumāṃ ṛtāvāpo vasāno adhi sāno avye . ava droṇāni ghṛtavanti roha madintamo matsara indrapānaḥ
english: Purify yourself, O Soma, honey-sweet, rich in truth, clothed in the waters upon the woolly ridge; descend into the ghee-filled troughs, most inebriating, exhilarating, drunk by Indra.

sanskrit: bhadrānkṛṇvannindrahavāntsakhibhya ā somo vastrā rabhasāni datte
english: Making good things for his friends who call upon Indra, Soma puts on his impetuous garments.

sanskrit: pra te dhārā madhumatīrasṛgranvāraṃ yatpūto atyeṣyavyam . pavamāna pavase dhāma gonāṃ janayantsūryamapinvo arkaiḥ
english: Your honey-sweet streams have been released, having passed through the barrier when purified, past the wool; O Pavamāna, you purify yourself as you generate the station of the cows, and you have swelled the sun with your rays.

sanskrit: pra gāyatābhyarcāma devāntsomaṃ hinota mahate dhanāya . svāduḥ pavatāmati vāramavyamā sīdatu kalaśaṃ deva induḥ
english: Sing forth, let us praise the gods; urge Soma on for great riches; may the sweet one purify himself past the woolen filter, may the divine drop take his seat in the vessel.

sanskrit: pra hinvāno janitā rodasyo ratho na vājaṃ saniṣannayāsīt . indraṃ gacchannāyudhā saṃśiśāno viśvā vasu hastayorādadhānaḥ
english: Pressing forward, the begetter of heaven and earth, like a chariot, has gone forward to win the prize; going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, he has placed all good things in his hands.
